rows.grounds: epithet of the goddess as one who put Kaṃsa to flight
name of the goddess Kaumārī, associated with Kumāra

items.question: What further epithets and qualities are ascribed to the goddess in this enumeration?
premises: The goddess is identified as the banisher of Kaṃsa.
The goddess bears the names Durgā, Kaumārī, and Kauśikī.
The goddess embodies the quality of forbearance.
items.inference: This verse continues the enumeration by attributing additional names and the quality of forbearance to the same goddess.
uncertainties: kṣamā may function as a proper name or as an abstract quality personified.
items.plain_english: She is the banisher of Kaṃsa, Durgā, Kaumārī, Kauśikī, and Forbearance.
